title: Measuring Spurious Correlation in Classification: "Clever Hans” in Translationese

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the alignment of unsupervised topics (generated via LDA and BERTopic) with target classification labels (original vs. translated texts) to quantify spurious topic correlations.

Masking specific named entities (such as locations, persons, and organizations) using automatic NER to mitigate spurious geographic and entity correlations, and evaluating the impact via classification accuracy and Integrated Gradients (IG) attributions.
